contentText: François Picard is pleased to welcome Tim Bale, Professor of Politics at Queen Mary, University of London. According to Professor Bale, Britain's Prime Minister Keir Starmer appears to have unwittingly misled Parliament, as a consequence of not being not being 'apprised' of Peter Mandelson's failed vetting. And while accountability remains elusive, Starmer's US Ambassador appointment was widely seen as a political risk taken under pressure: Mandelson reflected a strategic gamble shaped by anxiety over the Great Britain's relationship with the United States under Donald Trump.
